problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Unconstrained monotone root finding: a continuous operator F:E→E satisfies ⟨F(x)−F(y),x−y⟩≥0 and has a zero xstar with ‖x0−xstar‖≤R. E is a real inner product space; completeness and finite dimension are not assumed. No objective or gradient representation is required.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Exact operator evaluation: every query x returns F(x), independently of history and seed. No gradient structure is assumed. The extracted budget counts operator evaluations.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: Whenever ‖F(x+θ(y−x))‖≤M for every θ∈[0,1], ‖F(x)−F(y)‖≤(L0+L1 M)‖x−y‖. Parameters satisfy L0>0 and L1≥0.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: E,L0,L1,R,x0 are public, with R≥0 and a zero within distance R of x0. The tolerance ε>0 belongs only to Params: algorithm construction does not receive ε, although the execution budget depends on it.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The residual bound holds almost surely under the joint algorithm-seed and oracle-seed law, after execution with the supplied fixed oracle budget.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: The returned point must satisfy the unsquared operator residual bound ‖F(output)‖≤ε. There is no prescribed averaging or iterate-selection requirement.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Monotone root finding is classical, but the operator-norm-dependent segment Lipschitz condition is an unusual generalization of global Lipschitz continuity.

descriptionHtml:
Generalized Lipschitz Monotone Root Finding

We consider finding a zero of a continuous monotone operator F:E→E on a real inner product space E. For constants L0>0 and L1≥0, its Lipschitz bound along any segment is L0+L1M whenever M bounds ∥F∥ on that segment. A given point x0∈E is within distance R≥0 of a zero x⋆ of F. The oracle returns F(x) at x. For ε>0, the goal is an output x¯∈E with ∥F(x¯)∥≤ε almost surely under P, the law of the algorithm’s randomness.

The root-finding problem is to find x∈E such that F(x)=0. Write ⟨⋅,⋅⟩ for the inner product on E and ∥⋅∥ for its induced norm. The algorithm receives E, L0, L1, R, and x0; the tolerance ε may enter the oracle-call budget but is not an algorithm input.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Continuity and monotonicity). The operator F is continuous on E and satisfies ⟨F(x)−F(y),x−y⟩≥0,x,y∈E.

Assumption 2 (Generalized Lipschitz bound). For every x,y∈E and M∈R satisfying ∥F(x+θ(y−x))∥≤M,θ∈[0,1], we have ∥F(x)−F(y)∥≤(L0+L1M)∥x−y∥.

Assumption 3 (Initial distance to a zero). There exists x⋆∈E such that F(x⋆)=0,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R.

Queries may be made at any point of E. After the allotted oracle calls, the output must satisfy the residual criterion ∥F(x¯)∥≤εP-a.s.

comparisonHtml:
Let F:E→E be continuous and monotone on a real inner-product space, with L0>0, L1≥0, R≥0. For every x,y,M, if ∥F(x+θ(y−x))∥≤M for all θ∈[0,1], then ∥F(x)−F(y)∥≤(L0+L1M)∥x−y∥. A root x⋆ satisfies ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R. Access is to exact evaluations of F; the target is ∥F(x)∥≤ε, ε>0. No initial-residual bound is supplied.

Residual complexity for RadiusGeneralizedLipschitzMonotone.
Result Oracle complexity Novelty Limitations
(1) RadiusGeneralizedMonotone (Ours) (⋆⋆⋆) (review) O(1+L0Rε+(L1R)4/3)
(2) EG (Choudhury and Loizou 2025, Theorem 3.6); past-EG (Greenberg and Loizou 2026, Corollary 3.3). Unconstrained Rd. O(1+(L0Rε)2+(L1R)2) (1): A2→A, C2→C4/3; speedup Θ((1+A2+C2)/(1+A+C4/3)). Last iterate instead of minimum residual. Scope: arbitrary real inner-product spaces. (1) needs R in updates in addition to L0,L1.

Abbr: A=L0R/ε, C=L1R; costs count all exact F evaluations, including two per EG step and one new evaluation per past-EG step. O suppresses universal constants. The guarantee in (1) is deterministic.

import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Basic
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.ProbabilityMeasure
import LongTails.Template

open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace LongTails.Setups.RadiusGeneralizedLipschitzMonotone

open OracleTemplate

structure Public where
  E : Type u
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [linearE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  L0 : ℝ
  L1 : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  x0 : E

attribute [instance] Public.normedE Public.linearE

structure Params extends Public where
  ε : ℝ

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Public
  Instance p := p.E → p.E
  Query p := p.E
  Reply p := p.E
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput := Params.toPublic
  valid q := 0 < q.L0 ∧ 0 ≤ q.L1 ∧ 0 ≤ q.R ∧ 0 < q.ε
  admissible q F oracle :=
    (∀ k seed x, oracle.answer k (0, x) seed = F x) ∧
    Continuous F ∧
    (∀ x y, 0 ≤ ⟪F x - F y, x - y⟫) ∧
    (∀ x y M, (∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖F (x + θ • (y - x))‖ ≤ M) →
      ‖F x - F y‖ ≤ (q.L0 + q.L1 * M) * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∃ xstar, F xstar = 0 ∧ ‖q.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ q.R)
  successful q F output P :=
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂(P : MeasureTheory.Measure _), ‖F (output ω)‖ ≤ q.ε

end LongTails.Setups.RadiusGeneralizedLipschitzMonotone
